title: Cell Theory
subject: Biology
objective: Your body has about 37 trillion cells. Three scientists showed that every living thing is built from cells, and every cell comes from another cell.

fill.q: All living organisms are made of one or more ____.
The cell is the basic ____ and functional unit of life.
"Omnis cellula e cellula" means every cell comes from a ____ cell.
____ are an exception because they are not made of cells.

tf.q: Schleiden studied plants and Schwann studied animals.
tf.explain: Together they proposed that all organisms are made of cells.

tf.q: New cells can form from non-living matter.
tf.explain: Virchow: cells come only from pre-existing cells.

tf.q: Unicellular organisms also follow cell theory.
tf.explain: They are made of one cell.

ar.a: Viruses are an exception to cell theory.
ar.r: Viruses are not made of cells.
ar.explain: R is the reason they do not fit.

ar.a: New cells can arise from non-living matter.
ar.r: All cells arise from pre-existing cells.
ar.explain: A is false; R (Virchow) is true.

mcq.q: "All cells arise from pre-existing cells" was given by:
Which is not part of cell theory?
options: all organisms are made of cells
the cell is the basic unit of life

short.q: State the three points of cell theory with the scientists.
short.solution: All organisms are made of cells (Schleiden, Schwann); the cell is the basic unit of structure and function; all cells arise from pre-existing cells (Virchow).

short.q: Why are viruses an exception to cell theory?
short.solution: They are not made of cells and cannot reproduce on their own; they multiply only inside a host cell.

match.explain: Cell theory combined the work of several scientists.
